latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of maker-facebook — Facebook Video Maker:

- Create Facebook-ready videos from clips or images (supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG up to 500MB).
- Cloud rendering delivers 1080p MP4 files in about 1–2 minutes.
- Handles uploads, exports, editing (text overlays, music), and credits tracking.
- Streamlined setup: auto-connects to processing API and receives free token if needed.
- Supports video ad workflows for marketers and small business owners with simple prompts.
